scope: Corollary 8.9 (The oriented classification) of the manuscript “Positively curved Einstein four-manifolds” (preprints/Positively-curved-Einstein-four-manifolds-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 348 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2eb05d3e177c39f3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every connected oriented smooth closed Einstein four-manifold with strictly positive sectional curvature is, after positive scaling, isometric to the round S4 or to CP2 with its Fubini–Study metric.
